p['reviewers'][0]['authority']=trainer['signer']

findings.interpretation: A material-review false completion caused by inconsistent controller assignments for the same signing-key digest across two inputs. It was not a real-independence, native-adoption or production-authority acceptance.

The existing join is a conjunction under the same pinned campaign/source pair; it does not establish the original learning actor-to-control association. The fixture control identities are independent synthetic material, not genuine native actor mappings.
